reason: The old task-report mechanism is not promoted into RedCap 1.0. The useful 1.0 requirement is already narrower and executable: report, extraction, Prism review, ledger, receipt, or summary artifacts must not complete an extract-and-consume loop item unless paired with runtime, contract, knowledge, or RedCap command evidence.
kept_for_1_0: Human-readable status can support communication after changed reality exists.
Completion evidence must preserve original intent coverage and unresolved-work boundaries.
Reports or summaries may support verification but cannot serve as completion.
not_promoted_for_1_0: Report file presence as completion evidence.
Receipt or Prism result as the sole completed-state authority.
Closeout/report generation before changed runtime reality.
